SELECT h.name
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN (
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Likes
    GROUP BY student_id
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON h.ID = t.student_id;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT h.name
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN (
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Likes
    GROUP BY student_id
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON h.ID = t.student_id;
